description: This file contains utility functions and data structures for managing user credentials, including reading, saving, and setting active credentials, as well as handling configuration paths and environment variables.

classes.name: Credentials
classes.description: Struct representing user credentials with fields for name, username, auth token, method, instance URL, and active status.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the currentUser variable with the current OS user.

methods.name: getDefaultConfigHomePath
methods.description: Returns the default configuration directory path, considering environment variables.

methods.name: resolveConfigFilePath
methods.description: Resolves the full path to the configuration file, replacing environment variables.

methods.name: ReadCredentialsList
methods.description: Reads and parses the credentials list from the configuration file.

methods.name: GetCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves credentials by name from the credentials list.

methods.name: SaveCredentials
methods.description: Saves or updates a credentials entry in the credentials list.

methods.name: SaveCredentialsList
methods.description: Writes the entire credentials list to the configuration file.

methods.name: SetCurrent
methods.description: Sets a specific credentials entry as active by name.

methods.name: SetUser
methods.description: Sets the currentUser variable to the provided OS user.

methods.name: readSecretFromFile
methods.description: Reads a secret from a file and trims whitespace.
